game_mode.description: PvE, PvP, or PvE-competitive, from the Manifest activity mode category (activityModeCategory 1, 2, or 3).

fireteam_size.description: Fireteam size stated in Bungie's activity-type description (for Dungeons, 'up to three').

kind_of.description: The broader activity kind this entity is a special form of.

located_on.description: Destination where the activity takes place.

usual_ammo_type.description: Ammo type used by at least 95% of this archetype's collectible weapons in the cited Manifest snapshot; individual weapons can differ.

max_equipped_exotic_weapons.description: Exotic weapons that can be equipped at the same time.

max_equipped_exotic_armor.description: Exotic armor pieces that can be equipped at the same time.

exotic_weapon_and_armor_together.description: Whether one Exotic weapon and one Exotic armor piece can be equipped together (they use different uniqueLabels).

each_piece_restricted_to_one_class.description: Every item of this kind is restricted to one class and can only be equipped by that class.

class_restriction.description: Which class can equip an item. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

item_slot.description: Equipment slot of an item. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

item_tier.description: Rarity tier of an item. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

damage_type.description: Damage type of an item. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

item_type_label.description: Specific Manifest item type label. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

quest_reward_names.description: Reward names declared by a quest or bounty. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

ammo_type.description: Ammo type of one weapon. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.

matchmaking.description: Whether one activity is matchmade. Always read from the Manifest, never curated.
